description.en: Computer Engineering student focused on building practical web, mobile, and API solutions with clean execution and a strong learning mindset.

about.en: I am a Computer Engineering student at UCA, currently in my sixth term. I enjoy technology that makes work simpler, faster, and more reliable. I adapt quickly, learn fast, and feel comfortable collaborating with different teams while continuously improving both my technical skills and the way I organize my time.
about.es: Soy estudiante de Ingenieria Informatica en la UCA, actualmente en mi sexto ciclo. Disfruto la tecnologia que vuelve el trabajo mas simple, rapido y confiable. Me adapto con facilidad, aprendo rapido y me siento comodo colaborando con distintos equipos mientras sigo mejorando mis habilidades tecnicas y mi forma de organizar el tiempo.
